The '''440 freighter''' was an older model [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] produced by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]. It was operated by a crew of two plus two gunners.

==Known ships==
*''[[Isilia]]''<ref name="PC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 440 freighter first appeared in ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]'' in form of the freighter ''[[Isilia]]''. However, the ship's class was not revealed until the release of the [[The Star Wars Planets Collection|''Planets Collection'']] Sourcebook, which compiled and extended several entries of the three ''[[Planets of the Galaxy]]'' books.

All statistics are for the ''Isilia'', a modified variant.
